entities.summary: Alexi Ogando Acosta is a Dominican former professional baseball pitcher. He played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Texas Rangers, Boston Red Sox, Atlanta Braves and Cleveland Indians, and in the KBO League for the Hanwha Eagles. He was an MLB All-Star in 2011.
